DoorDash listing for this store is inactive ('not active', no menu). allmenus (tier 5, undated) was checked and rejected: several of its prices (e.g. Big Daddy $10.99) are lower than every dated photo found, including the oldest one, so it appears to be a stale/miscategorized capture, not a genuinely independent second source. Used Google Maps' Menu photo tab instead: reviewer-posted photographs of the restaurant's own printed menu boards and its illuminated exterior weekly-special sign. The exterior sign is the same physical sign photographed at three different times with the Mon-Thu steerburger special price literally increasing ($10.99 -> $12.99 -> $13.99 across three separate photos), which independently confirms a chronological price-increase sequence. Two older, lower-priced revisions of the interior board were also found (customer photos, with glare/reflections, at ~$1-2 lower per item and, for the oldest, different item names entirely - 'Super Burger'/'Cheeseburger' instead of 'World Famous Steerburger'). Used the newest revision throughout: the flat, clean scan of the full menu binder, whose weekly-special price ($13.99) matches the highest/most recent exterior sign reading. Full food menu captured: Salads, Dogs, From the Sea, Little Wranglers (kids), Weekly Specials, Desserts, Burgers, Specialty Baskets, Appetizers, Wings, Sides, Chicken, Chicken Specialty Baskets, Sandwich Baskets.
